label: SUBJECTS UNDER SURVEILLANCE
title: KNOWN
description: Individuals connected to the system, their activities, affiliations and surveillance records.

elliot.description: A cybersecurity engineer who secretly operates as a hacker. He has an exceptional ability to analyze systems, people and their vulnerabilities.

mrrobot.description: A figure representing the most aggressive and revolutionary side of the fsociety movement.

darlene.description: One of the primary technical members of fsociety, heavily involved in infiltration and operational planning.

angela.description: Elliot's childhood friend whose involvement with Allsafe and later E Corp becomes increasingly important.

tyrell.description: A senior technology executive at E Corp whose intense pursuit of power, status and control makes him a major figure.

price.description: The head of E Corp and a major player in corporate politics, economic power and global influence.

whiterose.description: The mysterious and powerful leader of the Dark Army, associated with long-term plans and covert operations.

dom.description: An FBI agent investigating activities connected to fsociety and the Dark Army.
